reason: The town gas tariff for households. The fuel cost adjustment, which changes each month and is added to every unit of gas, is not held, so a bill is the basic tariff only. Concession schemes and business tariffs are not held.

reason_local.text: 住宅用戶的煤氣收費。每月調整並加於每單位煤氣的燃料調整費未有收錄，因此賬單只計算基本收費。優惠計劃及工商業收費亦未有收錄。
